invite.title: Founding beta testers
invite.lead: Pet Friends is a community for pet lovers — browse animals, share updates in the feed, and use the marketplace. We are inviting a small founding group to test the product and tell us what to improve.
invite.whyBody: Real usage finds bugs, confusing flows, and missing features faster than we can alone. Your feedback guides what we build next.
invite.privacyBody: Treat other members’ personal data (names, contacts, photos, private messages) as confidential. Do not share it outside Pet Friends. If you find a security issue, report it to us privately — do not publish exploits.
invite.rewardsBody: Pet Friends will offer paid services such as promoted listings and ads, plus a points system for discounts. Points can be bought or earned through activity in the product.
invite.benefitBody: Depending on your testing activity, we plan to grant monthly bonus points and/or complimentary access to some paid services once those features launch. This is a soft-launch thank-you for active participation — not employment, not cash compensation, and not a guaranteed amount.
